text:
samir: FYI noticing an odd breakout after the RBAC attr rename + org key alias rotate. A few tenants got mass SCIM deprovs and the provisioner logs show both EnvelopeHeaderMismatch and a new MalformedEnvelopeVersion error. Anyone seen MalformedEnvelopeVersion before?

leah: I'm seeing the same in ap-northeast. Sample log: 
```
2026-09-01T18:12:02Z provisioner ERROR tenant=tidebank scim=deprov req=0a1b2c kms_err=EnvelopeHeaderMismatch expected_kid=key/old-101 got=key/new-202
2026-09-01T18:12:02Z provisioner ERROR tenant=tidebank scim=deprov req=0a1b2c kms_err=MalformedEnvelopeVersion: expected v2 got v0
2026-09-01T18:12:02Z audit WARN tenant=tidebank missing_row action=deprovision actor=svc-scim
```

tony: MalformedEnvelopeVersion is new to me. Could be old clients writing v0 envelopes into cache. We introduced envelope v2 last year; some tenants may still have v0 in long-tail caches (S3/redis). If alias rotated without rewrap, decrypt fails and then parsing hits v0 path which errors.

samir: Great catch. Timeline: alias rotate at 18:00 UTC, RBAC rename merged at 18:03 (NameID mapping email->persistent), rewrap job started but lambda timed out. Two things collided.

ops-bot: ALERT scim-deprov-cluster severity=high tenants=5 events=176 incident=INC-2026-999 created_by=ops-bot

leah: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) enable provisioner "defer" mode for ap-northeast so events queue instead of execute; 2) spin a targeted rewrap that supports v0->v2 migration (detect v0, transform metadata, re-encrypt with new alias); 3) deploy transient IdP shim to accept both NameID formats for 72h; 4) prepare audit backfill plan.

tony: Agree. Small nit: transforming v0 -> v2 needs to preserve original envelope metadata (created_at, origin_kid, envelope_version) so audit and debug can reconcile. The rewrap lambda must be careful.

samir: Can we also add an auto-safelist: if a tenant gets >10 EnvelopeHeaderMismatch within 5m after rotation, automatically move them to deferred-mode so we avoid destructive mass deprovs?

ops-bot: ACTION create-safelisting rule owner=leah condition=EnvelopeHeaderMismatch_rate>10/5m region=ap-northeast

leah: I'll flip deferred-mode now for ap-northeast. Doing it. Queue depth will grow but no destructive ops.

leah: flipped. monitoring: deprov events dropped ~92% for affected tenants. queue depth ~2.7k.

compliance-bot: NOTE audit-gap-detected tenants=3 missing_audit_rows=9 incident=INC-2026-999 severity=high

leah: snapshot plan: s3://secure/envelopes/INC-2026-999/raw/ then run rewrap-migrator lambda with timeout=1200s, concurrency=4. The migrator will: detect envelope version, if v0 -> migrate fields to v2 canonical form, decrypt with old kid(s), encrypt with current alias. Idempotent and manifest written.

tony: Add a dry-run mode first (decrypt+transform+validate but don't write) and run against a sample set of 50 envelopes to ensure no metadata loss. Also test decryption with both old and new keys.

leah: dry-run sample passes: 
```
2026-09-01T19:05:21Z migrator DEBUG tenant=tidebank sample=50 v0_detected=6 v2_detected=44 dryrun_ok=50/50
```
samir: Great. Next: IdP shim to accept legacy NameID (email) for match lookups. Leah, can you coordinate with IdP on a 72h fallback?

leah: On it. Pushing shim now.

ops-bot: NOTE incident INC-2026-999 state=mitigating owners=[leah,samir,tony] sla=72h

compliance-bot: NOTE backfill-policy: require legal signoff before inserting audit rows; backfilled rows must include backfill_metadata and a pointer to original_event_blob.

leah: Starting full migrator run now. Concurrency 4, writing manifest to s3://secure/envelopes/INC-2026-999/manifest.csv. Posting progress in incident.

leah: sample rewrap log: 
```
2026-09-01T19:28:03Z migrator INFO tenant=tidebank migrated=240/1200 v0->v2=18 reencrypt_old_kid=arn:aws:kms:...:key/old-101 new_kid=arn:aws:kms:...:key/new-202
```
tony: I'll draft the audit backfill proposal and ping Legal. Plan: export raw queue, reconcile after rewrap, insert audit rows with original timestamps and a backfill flag. Avoid changing original_event_blob.

compliance-bot: TASK create-legal-ticket owner=tony ticket=LEGAL-2026-455

leah: After first 2 batches noise dropped to near zero. Good signal. Continuing migrator. ETA ~2.5h at current rate.

samir: Postmortem checklist items: 1) pre-rotation must ensure rewrap migrator dry-run completes; 2) block RBAC nameid changes during KMS rotations; 3) make migrator hardened (longer timeout, version-detect, idempotent); 4) auto-safelist rule post-rotation.

tony: Also add telemetry: envelope_version metric, and after-rotation Mismatch-rate alert so we catch this earlier.

leah: Agreed. Will file follow-ups. Continuing run, posting updates to INC-2026-999.

samir: Thanks team. Keep comms in this thread. If any tenant still shows failures despite migrator, flag immediately with envelope sample and tenant id.
